snippet.description:
🧬 Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026 – Sickle Cell Anemia | Important Question Discussion | Principles of Inheritance and Variation | Kerala Class 12 Biology

Attention Kerala Plus Two Zoology students! Are you preparing for the upcoming Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026? Don't miss this important question discussion on Sickle Cell Anemia, a significant topic from the chapter Principles of Inheritance and Variation! 💯

In this RK Nex Plus Two session, we explain Sickle Cell Anemia, its genetic cause, inheritance pattern, molecular basis, and important examination-oriented concepts in a simple and easy-to-remember way.

Learn how a point mutation in the beta-globin gene causes sickle cell anemia, understand the substitution of glutamic acid by valine at the sixth position of the beta-globin chain, and discover how this genetic disorder follows an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern.

This session helps Kerala Plus Two students understand the topic clearly, remember important genetic concepts, and prepare confidently for the Christmas Examination 2026.

📌 In This Video:

✅ Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026
✅ Sickle Cell Anemia – Important Question Discussion
✅ Principles of Inheritance and Variation
✅ Genetic Disorders – Important Concepts
✅ Introduction to Sickle Cell Anemia
✅ Molecular Basis of Sickle Cell Anemia
✅ Point Mutation and Its Significance
✅ Mutation in the Beta-Globin Gene
✅ Glutamic Acid to Valine Substitution
✅ Sixth Position of the Beta-Globin Chain
✅ Normal Haemoglobin (HbA) and Sickle Haemoglobin (HbS)
✅ Autosomal Recessive Inheritance
✅ Homozygous and Heterozygous Conditions
✅ Sickle Cell Trait and Sickle Cell Disease
✅ Genotype-Based Genetics Questions
✅ Important Inheritance Patterns
✅ Sickle Cell Anemia – NCERT-Based Questions
✅ Important Short-Answer Questions
✅ Christmas Exam Genetics Revision
✅ Easy Tricks to Remember Genetic Concepts

🎯 Why Watch This Video?

Sickle Cell Anemia is an inherited genetic disorder caused by a mutation in the gene responsible for producing the beta-globin chain of haemoglobin.

In normal haemoglobin, the sixth amino acid of the beta-globin chain is glutamic acid, whereas in sickle haemoglobin, it is replaced by valine.

This substitution results from a single nucleotide change in the beta-globin gene.

The disorder follows an autosomal recessive inheritance pattern. Individuals with two HbS alleles generally develop sickle cell disease, while individuals with one HbA and one HbS allele usually have sickle cell trait.

Understanding the genetic cause, amino acid substitution, and inheritance pattern is important for answering examination-oriented questions from the Principles of Inheritance and Variation chapter.

This session simplifies these concepts through clear explanations and easy revision techniques.

Whether you're preparing for the Plus Two Christmas Exam 2026, Second Terminal Examination, or Plus Two Public Exam 2027, this video will help strengthen your Zoology preparation.

🚨 Plus Two Zoology – Sickle Cell Anemia ഇങ്ങനെ പഠിച്ചാൽ മറക്കില്ല!

💯 Understand the Mutation. Remember the Inheritance Pattern. Aim for A+!

📚 Subscribe to RK Nex Plus Two for more Plus Two Zoology Christmas Exam 2026 important questions, Genetics revision, Biology diagrams, previous year questions, chapter-wise discussions, and Kerala Plus Two Public Exam 2027 preparation.
